question: Odd one out: Battle of Swally, Captain Thomas Best, John Mildenhall, Cession of Bombay.
explanation: The Battle of Swally, Thomas Best, and the Cession of Bombay represent direct military or political clashes/treaties that undermined Portuguese monopoly in favor of the English. John Mildenhall was an explorer who travelled overland to the Mughal court and did not participate in naval actions.
